upsertFindings.claim: XFCE is installed on the system.
The fixed-function lighting block in glwidget.cpp has been restored to maintain visual parity between legacy and modern rendering tiers.
evidence: Tool evidence 100 (edit call=40b586aad50b152f) shows the insertion of glEnable(GL_LIGHTING) and glLightfv calls for LIGHT0 and LIGHT1 after glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE).

The edit references design.md D2, which mandates retaining the block if a regression appears in the parity harness.
